name: Alabama
notes: Colors: Crimson Flame #9E1B32 + Capstone Gray #828A8F (primary palette also includes Victory White). Secondary is a grey. Students get userID@crimson.ua.edu (lifelong, Microsoft 365); ua.edu is for faculty/staff and student-employee accounts. Greek: OFSL one-pager (Jan 2025) gives 13,000+ members (38% of undergrads). Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Arkansas
notes: Official primary colors: Razorback Red #9D2235 (web hex) + Apple Blossom (white). The print page gives Razorback Red as RGB 161/0/47 (about #A1002F), which does not match the web hex; use #9D2235 on screens. Secondary is white. Non-white options: Spoofer's Stone #464648, Silverleaf #C7C8C9. Students use @uark.edu. Greek: uagreeks.uark.edu only gives an undated '~30% of undergraduates', with no headcount, so null. Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Auburn
notes: Brand Center lists Auburn Blue #0B2341 then Auburn Orange #E86100 as the primary pair. FLAG: Auburn Blue is a very dark navy (contrast against black is 1.3:1). It is saturated, not grey, so the fallback rule will not trigger. Use orange if a brighter accent is wanted. Athletics hex UNVERIFIED: third-party sites give navy #0C2340 and orange #E87722/#F26522. Students use TigerMail at @auburn.edu. Greek: 2025-26 Greek Life Community Report says over 10,000 students (37% of undergrads).

name: Florida
notes: Brand Center names Core Orange #FA4616 and Core Blue #0021A5 as the primary colors (extended: Dark Blue #002657, Alachua #F2A900). Orange is only 3.5:1 against white, so avoid it for small white-on-orange text. Students use GatorLink username@ufl.edu. Greek: 2025-26 Guide to Florida Greeks says more than 8,300 members in 62 organizations. Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Georgia
notes: UGA's primary palette is Arch Black #000000, Bulldog Red #BA0C2F and Chapel Bell White. Red is used as the primary here. Secondary is pure black. The brand advises against red text on black. Students use MyID@uga.edu (UGAMail). Greek: UGA Student Affairs 2025 Greek Life Report gives 9,481 members. Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Kentucky
notes: Primary: Wildcat Blue #0033A0 (PMS 286) + White, from the April 2025 brand guidelines PDF. Secondary is white. Non-white options: Midnight #1B365D, Bluegrass #1E8AFF. Students use linkblue@uky.edu, with an optional first.last@uky.edu alias. Greek: no official current headcount found. The Kentucky IFC site claims 5,900+ (undated, not a university page), so null. Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: LSU
full_name: Louisiana State University and Agricultural and Mechanical College
notes: Official LSU Purple #461D7C (PMS 268) + Official LSU Gold #FDD023 (PMS 123), from the lsu.edu brand guide PDF. The guide also lists Corporate Purple #3C1053 and Corporate Gold #D29F13. Athletics (lsusports.net/media) uses the same purple and gold hex. The secondary gold is very light (L=0.66). Students use myLSU-name@lsu.edu (LSUMail). Greek: 2025-26 Community Scorecard gives 7,000+ members.

name: Ole Miss
notes: DEMO ORDER: navy primary so the tenant swap reads next to Alabama crimson (matches brand/theme/campus.ts). Official: Primary palette: Lyceum Red #CF142B, Oxford Blue #142142, Magnolia White. brand.olemiss.edu blocks direct fetches (HTTP 403), so these hex values come from search-index extracts of that official page; two independent queries agreed. Secondary Oxford Blue is near-black navy (L=0.016). Athletics hex UNVERIFIED: third-party sites give #CE1126 / #14213D. Students use WebID@go.olemiss.edu; olemiss.edu is faculty/staff (and legacy pre-2012 students). Postal address is 'University, MS'. Greek: FSL page reports 10,700+ affiliated undergraduates (2025).

name: Mississippi State
notes: Official palette PDF lists three primary colors: Maroon #5D1725 (PMS 505), Light Grey #C1C6C8 (PMS 428) and Dark Grey #777777. The PDF's own RGB for Dark Grey is 117/120/123 (#75787B), an internal mismatch. Maroon must dominate. Secondary is a light grey. The athletics branding portal uses the same maroon with white and gray. Statutory name: Mississippi State University of Agriculture and Applied Science. Postal address is 'Mississippi State, MS'. Students use NetID@msstate.edu. Greek: 38 chapters but no official headcount found, so null.

name: Mizzou
notes: Primary colors: Mizzou Gold #FDB719 + Tiger Paw Black #000000. Athletics uses the same gold ('Both the Mizzou campus and Mizzou Athletics use the same gold'). FLAG: the primary is a very light gold (1.8:1 against white). Secondary is pure black. Students use username@umsystem.edu. CAVEAT: umsystem.edu is shared with the other UM System campuses (UMKC, UMSL, Missouri S&T), so it does not prove Mizzou enrollment. missouri.edu is the employee domain. Greek: an undated official Student Affairs FSL page gives 7,500+ (about 27% of undergrads).

name: Oklahoma
notes: Primary: Oklahoma Crimson #841617. The traditional second color, Oklahoma Cream (PMS 468), is marked print-only with no hex, and OU says to use black or white instead in digital, so secondary is White. Cream #DDCBA4 appears only on third-party sites (UNVERIFIED, and off-brand for digital). Non-white options: Dark Crimson #4E0002 (accent), Dark Gray #323232 (neutral). Students use @ou.edu (default dotted address). Greek: FSPS landing page gives 7,400+ members (30% of undergrads). Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: South Carolina
notes: 'Garnet, black and white are the official colors': Garnet #73000A + Black #000000. Secondary is pure black. Students use username@email.sc.edu. Per a 2018 IT standard, employees use @mailbox.sc.edu with @sc.edu as the short form. Greek: Spring 2026 Greek report gives 9,879 members (Fall 2025: 10,176). Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Tennessee
notes: Tennessee Orange #FF8200 is the primary school color, with White and Smokey #4B4B4B as accents. Black is explicitly not in the palette; use Smokey instead. FLAG: the brand says the orange fails accessibility for type (2.5:1 against white). Secondary is white; Smokey #4B4B4B is the non-white option. Third-party sites give Smokey as #58595B (not official). Students use NetID@vols.utk.edu plus an @tennessee.edu alias (tennessee.edu is shared across the UT System). utk.edu is faculty/staff. Greek: UT News (2025) says 29% of undergrads, with no headcount, so null.

name: Texas
full_name: The University of Texas at Austin
notes: 'Burnt orange and white are the official colors': Burnt Orange #BF5700 (PMS 159) + White. Tints of burnt orange are not allowed. Secondary is white; Charcoal #333F48 (PMS 432) is the non-white option. Under the official student email rollout that began in Spring 2025, a student's official address is EID@my.utexas.edu. EID@eid.utexas.edu is the sign-in identifier and forwards to it. Bare @utexas.edu as a student address is UNVERIFIED (ITS lists austin.utexas.edu for employees). Greek: SFL Quick Facts gives 5,782 members (2023-24 Information Guide). Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Texas A&M
notes: 'Our primary palette consists of Aggie Maroon and white': Aggie Maroon #500000 (custom Pantone, ref. 7421) + White. FLAG: Aggie Maroon is very dark (contrast against black is 1.3:1). It is saturated, not grey. Secondary is white. Non-white options: secondary neutrals #3E3E3E and #707070, accent #732F2F. NetID@tamu.edu is the student forwarding address; NetID@email.tamu.edu is the Gmail mailbox. Greek: 5,778 is a FALL 2021 figure (Texas A&M Today). No newer official count was found. Athletics hex not checked separately.

name: Vanderbilt
notes: Core colors: Metallic Gold (a #FEEEB6 to #B49248 gradient), Flat Gold #CFAE70, Black #1C1C1C, White. Flat Gold is the solid primary. Athletics uses Flat Gold #CFAE70 and 'Rich Black' #000000; the academic black is #1C1C1C. FLAG: the primary is a light gold (2.1:1 against white) and the secondary is near-black. Students use @vanderbilt.edu; the address format comes from a dated page, but the domain is certain. Greek: Vanderbilt reports 33% of undergrads in 2025-26 with no headcount, so null.
